messages:
Maya Chen: flagging a P1 from Priya at Lumina Health — bulk welcome flow failing during OTP step for ~120 users. Failure rate ~95% in last 30m. Renewal in 14 days, customer is nervous. Stack: hosted. Error from logs:
```json
{"error":"OTP_INVALID","tenant":"lumina-42","time":"2026-03-20T19:02:11Z"}
```
Can CS own comms? @Jordan Lee

Jordan Lee: On it. Maya — do we know if it's tenant-specific? Also need impact numbers (paid seats affected). Priya, can you confirm renewal timeline? Assigning CS P1. :rotating_light:

Priya Singh: Renewal 2026-04-03 (firm). Affects invited users last 48h (stuck at verify). We can't collect usage data — this looks like a go-live blocker.

Anil Kapoor: quick triage — OTP signing key rotated in global KMS at ~18:40 UTC. Rotation hook didn't push to hosted-tenant cache for lumina-42. Short-term fix: run:
```bash
rws key-sync --tenant lumina-42 --key otp-signing
```
I'll kick a sync now.

Maya Chen: running key-sync... output: `synced=120, failed=0` — updating support ticket and pinging customer. deploy-bot: start rollback?

deploy-bot: Action: scheduled key-sync job executed by Anil. No rollback performed.

Jordan Lee: Good. Comms plan (short):
1) Acknowledge issue to Priya + ETA 1h.
2) Offer pro-rated credit for affected seats.
3) Schedule 30-min patch call today (15:30 PT).
4) Notify renewals owner and flag renewal risk.
Maya — can you draft the message and add to the ticket + set internal tag `cs:escalation`? I'll loop in renewals after your draft. :+1:

Priya Singh: Please include a one-line workaround for end-users (resend invite link) if fixed. Also want a clear note we expect a root-cause update before renewal review.

Maya Chen: Drafted and posted to ticket, cc'ed renewals. Will update here when users verify. Marking thread high priority.

Jordan Lee: :thumbsup: keep updates flowing. If this persists beyond 2h we'll open an SLA incident and trigger exec alert.

Anil Kapoor: following up with runtime team to add guard to rotation flow so tenant caches are invalidated reliably. Filing issue: RUNTIME-otp-rotation-cache.

Maya Chen: Closing loop — all 120 users verified after key-sync, Lumina confirms welcome flow now working. Priya: can we schedule a renewal health check next week to rebuild confidence? Jordan?

Priya Singh: Yes, next Tue works. Thanks all — appreciate the fast response.
